argv:
run-as com.cooper.lithic.m22verify.debug sh -c 'printf '"'"'M22_PROCESS_META_BEGIN
'"'"'; id -u; cat /proc/32313/stat; sed -n '"'"'/^Name:/p;/^Uid:/p;/^State:/p;/^VmRSS:/p;/^Threads:/p'"'"' /proc/32313/status; printf '"'"'M22_FD_TARGET_SNAPSHOT
'"'"'; for f in /proc/32313/fd/*; do v=$(readlink "$f"); case "$v" in /data/user/0/com.cooper.lithic.m22verify.debug/no_backup/*|/data/data/com.cooper.lithic.m22verify.debug/no_backup/*) printf '"'"'%s -> %s
'"'"' "${f##*/}" "$v";; esac; done; printf '"'"'M22_PROCESS_META_END
'"'"''
